svg.title: The Chasm Crossing: ledges and objective placement
svg.desc: Show where the Survey Map, ledges, Chasm and Cartographer's Stone sit relative to the shared deployment edge, and how Jump applies to ledge gaps.

text.tspan: both parties use the start-side short edge, within 8" of it; no Hero
a carried objective that starts on the start side, 3" from the first

svg.text: ledge. Its carrier's Speed is reduced by 1" while carrying it.

text.tspan: 3–4 narrow (1" wide) platform markers bridging the Chasm, with

svg.text: 1–2" gaps that require a Jump. 1–2 ledges are marked Crumbling: a Hero ending
an activation on one makes a DEX Check and falls on a failure.

text.tspan: a 1" marker on the delivery side, 3" from the last ledge.

svg.text: The first party to place the Survey Map adjacent to it wins immediately.

text.tspan: each 1" jumped costs 2" of movement; declare a

svg.text: landing point, then make a DEX Check. A failed Jump into the Chasm causes a

text.tspan: a combatant Pushed off a Ledge into the Chasm, or that fails a Crumbling Ledge Check and falls, is immediately

svg.text: removed from play. A Hero is Defeated and makes a normal Injuries Roll. A non-Hero is resolved as though reduced to 0 HP. This
replaces the normal Falling rule. Any carried items, including the Survey Map, fall into the Chasm and are lost.

text.tspan: Hero or Hireling with a Fly or Climb Speed
that would fall may immediately spend 1 unspent AP, including AP reserved for

svg.text: Reactions, to catch themselves. Place them Prone in the nearest legal space on a Ledge, and end their current movement. If they
cannot spend the AP, resolve the Chasm Fall normally.

text.tspan: Monster with a Fly or Climb Speed
that would fall is placed Prone in the nearest legal space on a Ledge, and their activation
